mistakes.feedback_en: A time phrase meaning “now” shows an action in progress, so use Present Continuous: “are shaking”.

mistakes.feedback_sk: „Shaking their hands“ znie, akoby trasú vlastnými rukami. Podanie rúk je „shaking hands“.

mistakes.feedback_en: “Shaking their hands” sounds like they shake their own hands; the greeting is “shaking hands”.
